_comment: Hum suggestion identity (lib/suggestion-key.mjs): how one place or event keeps one key across sources. Copy to agent/local/config/suggestion-key.json. `event_lanes`: extra lanes keyed like concerts (act + venue); `name_city_tags` / `area_city_tags`: trailing city or borough tags your sources append, stripped from names and areas; `name_dash_suffixes`: what may follow ' — ' after a place name and is dropped. Values are regex alternation fragments, matched case-insensitively.
